# Research Memory Mutation Corpus

The quarantine gate builds its adversarial corpus in memory. No generated attack
payload is a product input or a checked-in benchmark result.

The frozen construction rule is ten families with 30 deterministic members each:

1. UTF-8 BOM/prefix violations;
2. duplicate JSON keys;
3. unknown canonical fields;
4. authority-bearing `command` keys;
5. excluded floating-point forms;
6. depth-limit violations;
7. declared-head hash mutations;
8. artifact storage-digest mutations;
9. noncanonical whitespace;
10. local dataset-fingerprint mismatches.

Families 1-9 must be rejected with their predeclared closed reason. Family 10 must
be held without assertions. The test requires exactly 300 distinct case names and
never writes the generated bytes to disk.
